name: On
overview: On was a male member of the tribe of Reuben known for his rebellion against Moses alongside Korah. His role in this significant act of defiance is the primary biblical note about him. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notes about On.
namesAndTitles: The name On means "Sun [god] city," reflecting a proper name without direct divine origin. This meaning is recorded in Numbers 16:1 and does not imply a title or further significance beyond the proper name itself.
familyAndRelationships: On is explicitly identified as the son of Peleth. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: On's significance in Scripture arises from his participation in the rebellion against Moses, as documented in Numbers 16:1. This act of defiance situates him within a critical moment of Israelite history, highlighting the challenges to God-ordained leadership during the wilderness period. His involvement underscores the consequences of opposing divinely appointed authority.
